image_description: A close-up, front-facing shot of a golden hamster gripping the edge of a white paper or cardboard structure. The hamster has dense golden-brown fur, prominent dark eyes, and rounded ears. Its front paws are visible holding the object, while its lower body is partially obscured by red material. The background features a colorful, patterned surface with yellow and red stripes.

Both eyes are visible, appearing as distinct, small, dark beads consistent with hamster anatomy.
Both ears are visible, upright, rounded, and proportionally large relative to the head size.
